body:
MySQL 8.4's default utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci can equate strings differing in case and accents. The conformance fixture uses binary collation when exact comparison is required. Select the schema collation intentionally; changing only a dialect does not make Eq byte-exact. The explicit default-collation test demonstrates the difference.

Evidence: ds:block?id=mysql-collation-vqcp6ms3. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: MySQL equality follows column collation
